fullText.simplified:
徐州的新市长

    刘备看看吕布，再看看信，不知道这信是从哪儿来的。但是他知道，现在吕布正在生气，他说什么吕布都不会相信。现在他能做的，就是怎么让吕布不杀他。
    “我知道您不会相信我。”刘备很难过，“这样吧！现在，徐州是您的，我带着家人去您的小城住。您觉得怎么样？”
    吕布看着刘备，想起这几年那些将军们都不喜欢他，只有刘备照顾他，给他住的地方，给他吃的，和他做朋友，还是刘备对他最好。终于，他放下刀，让刘备带着家人走了。
    就这样，徐州又有了新市长——吕布。
    吕布觉得很好，因为他终于又有了自己的大城市，他每天都很高兴。很快，他就有了更多的钱和助手。他非常喜欢一个叫耳等的助手。这个助手每天都跟他说好话。
    陈公不太喜欢耳等，经常告诉吕布不要相信耳等，还说曹操会再来，要多做准备。开始的时候，吕布会听陈公的话。但是，人都喜欢听好话。慢慢地，他越来越不喜欢陈公了，觉得陈公是害怕耳等比自己好。陈公没办法，只好经常去城外玩，让自己高兴一点儿。
    一天，陈公又去城外玩。他在路上看到一个人，这个人一看到他就跑。他觉得很奇怪。
fullText.traditional:
徐州的新市長

    劉備看看呂布，再看看信，不知道這信是從哪兒來的。但是他知道，現在呂布正在生氣，他說什麼呂布都不會相信。現在他能做的，就是怎麼讓呂布不殺他。
    “我知道您不會相信我。”劉備很難過，“這樣吧！現在，徐州是您的，我帶著家人去您的小城住。您覺得怎麼樣？”
    呂布看著劉備，想起這幾年那些將軍們都不喜歡他，只有劉備照顧他，給他住的地方，給他吃的，和他做朋友，還是劉備對他最好。終於，他放下刀，讓劉備帶著家人走了。
    就這樣，徐州又有了新市長——呂布。
    呂布覺得很好，因為他終於又有了自己的大城市，他每天都很高興。很快，他就有了更多的錢和助手。他非常喜歡一個叫耳等的助手。這個助手每天都跟他說好話。
    陳公不太喜歡耳等，經常告訴呂布不要相信耳等，還說曹操會再來，要多做準備。開始的時候，呂布會聽陳公的話。但是，人都喜歡聽好話。慢慢地，他越來越不喜歡陳公了，覺得陳公是害怕耳等比自己好。陳公沒辦法，只好經常去城外玩，讓自己高興一點兒。
    一天，陳公又去城外玩。他在路上看到一個人，這個人一看到他就跑。他覺得很奇怪。

sentences.traditional: 劉備看看呂布，再看看信，不知道這信是從哪兒來的。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi kàn kan lǚ bù zài kàn kan xìn bù zhī dào zhè xìn shì cóng nǎ'r lái de
sentences.english: Liu Bei looked at Lü Bu and then looked at the letter. He didn’t know where the letter had come from.

sentences.simplified: 但是他知道，现在吕布正在生气，他说什么吕布都不会相信。
sentences.traditional: 但是他知道，現在呂布正在生氣，他說什麼呂布都不會相信。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā zhī dào xiàn zài lǚ bù zhèng zài shēng qì tā shuō shén me lǚ bù dōu bú huì xiāng xìn
sentences.english: But he knew that Lü Bu was angry, and Lü Bu would not believe anything he said.

sentences.simplified: 现在他能做的，就是怎么让吕布不杀他。
sentences.traditional: 現在他能做的，就是怎麼讓呂布不殺他。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā néng zuò de jiù shì zěn me ràng lǚ bù bù shā tā
sentences.english: Now all he could do was to stop Lü Bu killing him.

sentences.simplified: “我知道您不会相信我。”
sentences.traditional: “我知道您不會相信我。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nín bú huì xiāng xìn wǒ
sentences.english: “I know you won’t believe me.”

sentences.simplified: 刘备很难过，“这样吧！现在，徐州是您的，我带着家人去您的小城住。
sentences.traditional: 劉備很難過，“這樣吧！現在，徐州是您的，我帶著家人去您的小城住。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi hěn nán guò zhè yàng ba xiàn zài xú zhōu shì nín de wǒ dài zhe jiā rén qù nín de xiǎo chéng zhù
sentences.english: Liu Bei was very sad, “How about this? Now, Xuzhou is yours, I’ll go and live in your little city with my family.

sentences.simplified: 您觉得怎么样？”
sentences.traditional: 您覺得怎麼樣？”
sentences.pinyin: nín jué de zěn me yàng
sentences.english: What do you think?”

sentences.simplified: 吕布看着刘备，想起这几年那些将军们都不喜欢他，只有刘备照顾他，
sentences.traditional: 呂布看著劉備，想起這幾年那些將軍們都不喜歡他，只有劉備照顧他，
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù kàn zhe liú bèi xiǎng qǐ zhè jǐ nián nà xiē jiāng jūn men dōu bù xǐ huan tā zhǐ yǒu liú bèi zhào gù tā
sentences.english: Lü Bu looked at Liu Bei and remembered those years when the generals didn’t like him, and only Liu Bei took care of him.

sentences.simplified: 给他住的地方，给他吃的，和他做朋友，还是刘备对他最好。
sentences.traditional: 給他住的地方，給他吃的，和他做朋友，還是劉備對他最好。
sentences.pinyin: gěi tā zhù de dì fang gěi tā chī de hé tā zuò péng you hái shi liú bèi duì tā zuì hǎo
sentences.english: Liu Bei gave him a place to live, food to eat, and became his friend. It was Liu Bei who treated him the best.

sentences.simplified: 终于，他放下刀，让刘备带着家人走了。
sentences.traditional: 終於，他放下刀，讓劉備帶著家人走了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú tā fàng xià dāo ràng liú bèi dài zhe jiā rén zǒu le
sentences.english: Finally, he put down his sword and let Liu Bei take his family away.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，徐州又有了新市长——吕布。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，徐州又有了新市長——呂布。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng xú zhōu yòu yǒu le xīn shì zhǎng lǚ bù
sentences.english: Just like that, Xuzhou had a new mayor — Lü Bu.

sentences.simplified: 吕布觉得很好，因为他终于又有了自己的大城市，他每天都很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 呂布覺得很好，因為他終於又有了自己的大城市，他每天都很高興。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù jué de hěn hǎo yīn wèi tā zhōng yú yòu yǒu le zì jǐ de dà chéng shì tā měi tiān dōu hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: Lü Bu felt very good, because he finally had his own big city again and he was happy every day.

sentences.simplified: 很快，他就有了更多的钱和助手。他非常喜欢一个叫耳等的助手。
sentences.traditional: 很快，他就有了更多的錢和助手。他非常喜歡一個叫耳等的助手。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài tā jiù yǒu le gèng duō de qián hé zhù shǒu tā fēi cháng xǐ huan yí ge jiào ěr děng de zhù shǒu
sentences.english: Soon, he had more money and assistants. He was very fond of an assistant named Erdeng.

sentences.simplified: 这个助手每天都跟他说好话。
sentences.traditional: 這個助手每天都跟他說好話。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge zhù shǒu měi tiān dōu gēn tā shuō hǎo huà
sentences.english: This assistant said nice things to him every day.

sentences.simplified: 陈公不太喜欢耳等，经常告诉吕布不要相信耳等，
sentences.traditional: 陳公不太喜歡耳等，經常告訴呂布不要相信耳等，
sentences.pinyin: chén gōng bú tài xǐ huan ěr děng jīng cháng gào su lǚ bù bú yào xiāng xìn ěr děng
sentences.english: The Duke of Chen did not like Erdeng and told Lü Bu not to trust Erdeng.

sentences.simplified: 还说曹操会再来，要多做准备。
sentences.traditional: 還說曹操會再來，要多做準備。
sentences.pinyin: hái shuō cáo cāo huì zài lái yào duō zuò zhǔn bèi
sentences.english: He also said that Cao Cao would come again and that he should be more prepared.

sentences.simplified: 开始的时候，吕布会听陈公的话。但是，人都喜欢听好话。
sentences.traditional: 開始的時候，呂布會聽陳公的話。但是，人都喜歡聽好話。
sentences.pinyin: kāi shǐ de shí hou lǚ bù huì tīng chén gōng de huà dàn shì rén dōu xǐ huan tīng hǎo huà
sentences.english: Initially, Lü Bu would listen to the Duke of Chen. But people like to hear nice things.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，他越来越不喜欢陈公了，觉得陈公是害怕耳等比自己好。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，他越來越不喜歡陳公了，覺得陳公是害怕耳等比自己好。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de tā yuè lái yuè bù xǐ huan chén gōng le jué de chén gōng shì hài pà ěr děng bǐ zì jǐ hǎo
sentences.english: Slowly, he grew to dislike the Duke of Chen. He thought the Duke of Chen was afraid that Erdeng was better than him.

sentences.simplified: 陈公没办法，只好经常去城外玩，让自己高兴一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 陳公沒辦法，只好經常去城外玩，讓自己高興一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: chén gōng méi bàn fǎ zhǐ hǎo jīng cháng qù chéng wài wán ràng zì jǐ gāo xìng yì diǎn'r
sentences.english: The Duke of Chen could only take regular trips outside the city for pleasure and make himself a little happier.

sentences.simplified: 一天，陈公又去城外玩。
sentences.traditional: 一天，陳公又去城外玩。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān chén gōng yòu qù chéng wài wán
sentences.english: One day, the Duke of Chen took another trip outside the city for pleasure.

sentences.simplified: 他在路上看到一个人，这个人一看到他就跑。他觉得很奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 他在路上看到一個人，這個人一看到他就跑。他覺得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài lù shang kàn dào yí ge rén zhè ge rén yí kàn dào tā jiù pǎo tā jué de hěn qí guài
sentences.english: During the journey, he saw a man. The man ran away as soon as he saw him. He thought it was very strange.

sentence_translations: The New Mayor of Xuzhou
Liu Bei looked at Lü Bu and then looked at the letter. He didn’t know where the letter had come from.
But he knew that Lü Bu was angry, and Lü Bu would not believe anything he said.
Now all he could do was to stop Lü Bu killing him.
“I know you won’t believe me.”
Liu Bei was very sad, “How about this? Now, Xuzhou is yours, I’ll go and live in your little city with my family.
What do you think?”
Lü Bu looked at Liu Bei and remembered those years when the generals didn’t like him, and only Liu Bei took care of him.
Liu Bei gave him a place to live, food to eat, and became his friend. It was Liu Bei who treated him the best.
Finally, he put down his sword and let Liu Bei take his family away.
Just like that, Xuzhou had a new mayor — Lü Bu.
Lü Bu felt very good, because he finally had his own big city again and he was happy every day.
Soon, he had more money and assistants. He was very fond of an assistant named Erdeng.
This assistant said nice things to him every day.
The Duke of Chen did not like Erdeng and told Lü Bu not to trust Erdeng.
He also said that Cao Cao would come again and that he should be more prepared.
Initially, Lü Bu would listen to the Duke of Chen. But people like to hear nice things.
Slowly, he grew to dislike the Duke of Chen. He thought the Duke of Chen was afraid that Erdeng was better than him.
The Duke of Chen could only take regular trips outside the city for pleasure and make himself a little happier.
One day, the Duke of Chen took another trip outside the city for pleasure.
During the journey, he saw a man. The man ran away as soon as he saw him. He thought it was very strange.
